Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent 2D anime action RPG enemy sprite atlas. Create ONE production atlas containing exactly 12 isolated full-body BLEACH enemy character cutouts. Layout: an EXACT uniform grid of THREE columns by FOUR rows, no gaps between the invisible equal-sized cells, portrait canvas. Each subject is centered inside its assigned cell with 12 percent clear transparent padding on all edges; the full head, weapons and feet fit in that cell. Every subject faces slightly left in a readable fighting idle pose. Clean inked anime cel shading, recognizable canon faces, masks, outfits and weapons. Canon named characters are their original BLEACH designs, not new original villains. Faction troops follow the described standard uniform or Hollow anatomy. No bikini changes to enemies; preserve original enemy clothing. Monsters retain monster proportions; humanoids have natural adult proportions. True transparent alpha background across the whole sheet, no scenery, no cast shadows, no floor, no text, no labels, no grid lines, no borders, no logos. Keep silhouettes separate without touching other cells. Exact cell order, top row to bottom, left to right:
Cell 1 (row 1, column 1): 피시본 D. Identity and silhouette: 물고기 뼈를 닮은 큰 흰 가면과 우람한 팔을 가진 초기 호로.
Cell 2 (row 1, column 2): 애시드와이어. Identity and silhouette: 긴 뱀 같은 하체와 흰 가면, 머리카락이 남은 호로의 실루엣.
Cell 3 (row 1, column 3): 헥사포더스. Identity and silhouette: 여러 다리와 거대한 가면을 가진 낮은 짐승형 호로.

Cell 5 (row 2, column 2): 벌보스 G. Identity and silhouette: 커다란 가면과 부풀어 오른 거체가 눈에 띄는 초기 호로.
Cell 6 (row 2, column 3): 메타스타시아. Identity and silhouette: 머리 주변의 촉수와 사족형 몸체가 특징인 실험 호로.

Cell 8 (row 3, column 2): 호로·근접형. Identity and silhouette: 원작 호로의 흰 가면·검은 구멍·짐승형 몸을 따르는 일반형.
Cell 9 (row 3, column 3): 호로·비행형. Identity and silhouette: 날개와 긴 흰 가면을 가진 일반 호로 병과.
Cell 10 (row 4, column 1): 호로·돌진형. Identity and silhouette: 낮고 굵은 네 다리와 큰 뿔 모양 가면의 일반 호로.

Cell 12 (row 4, column 3): 호로·영탄형. Identity and silhouette: 가면의 입 부분이 길게 열린 일반 호로.
